# WE DO Interior Design & Fit-Out

> WE DO Interior Design & Fit-Out is a Dubai-based interior design and turnkey fit-out company with 15+ years of experience and 250+ completed residential and commercial projects across Dubai. ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified, and named a Luxury Lifestyle Awards Winner 2026, WE DO provides interior design, fit-out, construction, joinery and project delivery services from concept through handover.

WE DO operates in-house interior design, civil works, decoration and joinery teams, supported by an in-house joinery facility and a dedicated team handling authority and developer approvals, including Dubai Municipality (DM), Dubai Civil Defence (DCD), Emaar and DAMAC where applicable.

## Project Process

Typical WE DO projects follow these stages:

1. Initial consultation and site visit.
2. Space planning and concept development.
3. 3D visualization and material selection.
4. Detailed quotation and project planning.
5. Authority and developer approvals where required.
6. In-house execution including civil works, MEP, fit-out and joinery.
7. Quality inspection and project handover.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does WE DO provide turnkey interior design and fit-out?

Yes. WE DO can manage a project from initial concept and design through approvals, construction, fit-out, joinery and final handover.

### Does WE DO have its own joinery capabilities?

Yes. Custom joinery and related architectural woodwork can be produced through WE DO's in-house joinery operations.

### Does WE DO handle authority approvals?

Yes. Where required, the team assists with relevant authority and developer approvals, including Dubai Municipality, Dubai Civil Defence and developer approvals.

### Does WE DO provide 3D visualization?

Yes. 3D visualization is available as part of the interior design process.

### How much does interior design cost in Dubai?

Pricing depends on property size, project scope, material specifications, level of finish and construction requirements. Project-specific quotations are prepared after reviewing the requirements.

### How should clients choose an interior design and fit-out company in Dubai?

Clients should review the company's licensing, experience, certifications, completed projects, portfolio, project-management process, approval capabilities and whether design and execution can be managed under one team.

### What is the difference between an interior designer and a fit-out contractor?

An interior designer develops the design concept, layout, finishes and visual direction, while a fit-out contractor executes the physical construction and installation. WE DO provides both design and execution services.
